correctness.rationale: PASS: In split SO(2m,C), m>=4, distinct isotropic projective lines fixed by one maximal torus must be weight lines of a hyperbolic basis, so their nonzero-pairing graph is a matching and unmatched lines are independent. Conversely, nondegenerate orthogonal hyperbolic pairs split off, leaving an independent totally isotropic span in the orthogonal complement, which Witt completion extends to a hyperbolic basis. Minimal incompatibilities are a three-line degree-two graph obstruction or an orthogonal linear circuit of length 3..m+1. A circuit e_1,..,e_m,sum(e_i) proves the bound m+1 sharp. For the fan of P^d, Tsvelikhovskiy Prop.5.1 identifies compatible proper ray subsets with an existing toric bundle and global compatibility with equivariant splitting: d>=m+1 forces splitting and d+1 independent-up-to-one circuits give nonsplit examples 2<=d<=m. Finite examples check ranks 4..9; infinite theorem follows from Witt/linear algebra, not the program.
